
## Install

1. Download **NeedleX-<version>.dmg** below. It runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 13 or later.
2. Open it and drag **NeedleX** into **Applications**.
3. Open NeedleX from Applications. It isn't notarized by Apple yet, so the first time macOS says
   it can't check it. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click
   **Open Anyway** next to NeedleX, then confirm. You only need to do this once.
   (Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/NeedleX.app` in Terminal.)
4. NeedleX lives in the menu bar (no Dock icon). Play something in Spotify or Music and allow
   NeedleX to control it when macOS asks.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksums of the files.
